customer_complaints_escalation: 1) First report to your DisCo Customer Complaints Unit (CCU).
2) If unresolved, escalate to the NERC Forum Office covering your area.
3) If still unresolved, escalate to NERC Headquarters / NERC complaints channels.
sources_hint: NERC publishes official HQ contacts and Forum Office contacts.
Each DisCo publishes its own official customer care channels.

embedded_distribution_network_operators_.note: Nigeria also has licensed Independent Electricity Distribution Network Operators (IEDNOs) beyond the 11 DisCos. Keep these in a separate dataset if you want JusticeBot to route ‘estate/industrial park’ electricity disputes.

default_structure.to: Primary responsible entity (usually the DisCo MD/CEO for billing/metering/outage, or GenCo/TCN where directly responsible).
through: Regulatory escalation path where appropriate (e.g., NERC Forum Office / NERC HQ).
Oversight Ministry (policy) may be copied for systemic issues.
cc: Relevant DisCo/TCN department (Customer Care / Commercial / Technical)
PCC / FCCPC (where consumer rights & maladministration/poor complaint handling is involved)

how_to_write_titles: Use office titles, not personal names (e.g., 'Managing Director/CEO', 'Chairman', 'Honourable Minister').
State the customer identifiers: account number, meter number, address, feeder, and chronology of events.
Attach evidence: bills, payment receipts, debit alerts, photos, incident reports, reference numbers.
